run_model_textile_classification: run the textile classification model on a dataloader and save predictions to an npy file
get_accuracy_from_predictions: get the accuracy score by comparing ground truth labels against predicted labels from saved outputs
get_overall_metrics_classification: compute overall classification metrics including accuracy, top-k accuracy, balanced accuracy, and confidence intervals
